content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the Apply control gives no visible response after the first click, so the same spot is clicked again; in session S5360a38e, five Apply clicks at the same position (events 109, 115, 120, 125, 131) fall within about 0.8 s with no navigation, coverage, error, or state-change event between them.", "fix": "Fix: On the ir swap screen, disable the Apply button (the span at the Apply position) and show a pending indicator as soon as it is first clicked, keeping it disabled until the apply request resolves.", "cited_event_ids": ["109", "115", "120", "125", "131", "126:135"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The windows contain no event showing what the app does after an Apply click (no response, spinner, or result event is captured between the clicks), so the lack of feedback is inferred from absence.", "The visible error at event 63:a64 (on the Counterparty field, before Apply) may or may not relate to the Apply clicks; this is not confirmed.", "Whether the Apply request is slow or whether the button stays enabled in the UI could not be verified from the events.", "The sessions S8626cd0b and S7cb8c1c8 show the same burst pattern but were not analysed in detail here.", "The Apply burst does not appear to lead to abandonment in the facts, and the success event (app_action) occurs only later, after the Save flow."]}
